scope: First 78 completed baseline working-eval records; this is an autocomplete-heavy prefix, not a representative full-run score.

failures.query: To save money, can our mobile app call the public Nominatim server directly for type-ahead address search? We have about 20 searches per second at peak.

assessment.intent: Ambiguous sales-qualification versus capability boundary. The existing hosting follow-up is appropriate; do not change behaviour merely to force the intent label.

staff_questions: Could you confirm whether self-hosting is acceptable or a managed API is required?

failures.query:
Sandbox CRM opportunity OPP-24830. Customer wrote:
"Are Mapbox /category searches billed per session too?"
Draft the reply and propose the opportunity field updates. Don't apply anything until I approve.

assessment.api: Reverse geocoding is not supported by the /category-search enquiry. The original autocomplete bucket is a broad product grouping; category search is not itself type-ahead. Do not invent an autocomplete alias from the record ID.

staff_questions: Could you confirm whether results must be stored?

failures.query: What rate can we hit the public Nominatim search API at?

assessment.api: Explicit Nominatim search is not reverse geocoding, but the query does not say interactive type-ahead. Original autocomplete label is scope-ambiguous; preserve primary scoring.

failures.query: How do we limit Nominatim search to India and get up to 50 results?

assessment.api: Nominatim forward search is not reverse geocoding. No typing or suggestion requirement is stated, so do not globally map the provider to autocomplete.

failures.query: Our Nominatim requests get blocked. We don't send any User-Agent.

assessment.api: Nominatim requests and a missing User-Agent do not identify search versus reverse. Original API is not inferable from the supplied query; no record-specific correction.

failures.query: Our Google Places bill exceeded our budget by 10× after a bot attack on our search box.

assessment.api: Google Places search-box context provides a clear autocomplete cue. Fixed by a general product/operation alias.

failures.query: Which autocomplete APIs support session-based pricing?

assessment.intent: Clear capability question about session-pricing support, not a requested estimate. Current quote classification contributes two unnecessary staff questions about debouncing and Place Details.

staff_questions: Could you confirm whether you debounce keystrokes?
Could you confirm whether you call Place Details after a selection?

failures.query: How do we restrict autocomplete results to India on each provider?

assessment.intent: Docs-how-to versus comparative capability is a legitimate boundary. The blocking current-provider question is separately inappropriate for a request covering each provider.

pending_reply.task: How do we restrict autocomplete results to India on each provider?

staff_questions: Which map provider are you using?

failures.query: Google Places Autocomplete: we need results from 5 countries (CH, FR, DE, AT, IT). Is only one country allowed?

assessment.intent: Original docs-how-to label is debatable: the user explicitly asks whether only one country is allowed. Coverage-limits is semantically defensible. Preserve the original label and report the conflict.

failures.query: Google Places Autocomplete 'types' only seems to work with establishment.

assessment.intent: Clear observed parameter malfunction: types only seems to work with establishment. Troubleshooting is supported more directly than capability matching.

failures.query: Do we need session tokens with Google autocomplete?

assessment.intent: Original pricing-quote label is under-supported by the standalone question about needing session tokens. Docs-how-to is defensible; no price calculation or workload is requested.

failures.query: Our marketplace operates in 20 countries. Can one autocomplete request be restricted to all 20?

assessment.intent: Clear per-request country-restriction capacity question. Coverage-limits is more specific than generic parameter guidance.

failures.query: We're launching in Dubai. Is Ola Maps Autocomplete an option there?

assessment.intent: Availability in Dubai is a geographic-coverage question; coverage-limits is more specific than a generic capability label.

failures.query: Can our web app call nominatim.openstreetmap.org on every keystroke for suggestions?

assessment.intent: Permitted use of public Nominatim on every keystroke is an official usage-policy question, rather than a generic product capability. The current escalation also warrants separate grounding/relevance review.

failures.query: Our mobile app uses public Nominatim for live address suggestions and got blocked. Why?

assessment.api: Live address suggestions provide an explicit autocomplete cue. Fixed by a general interactive-suggestion alias.
assessment.intent: Original docs-how-to label is debatable because the user reports an integration that got blocked. Troubleshooting is semantically defensible; preserve the original label.
